decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement, PD1_000, PL1_00, Flood Risk Assessment, PL01MMA_04, PL01MMA_03, PL01MMA_02, PL01MMA_01 Received: 29 April 2015 PL01MMA_03, Unnumbered Proposed Front Elevation Received: 24 June 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side and rear walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of condtion 3 to amend the design of the proposal of Planning Permission 00698/7B/P1 dated 26/11/2013 for the erection of a new garden wall with 2 pillars and a gate, conversion of garage into hibatable room and the enlargement of front bay window to ground floor level
